title: Bump opum-lore pin to lore-cli v0.6.2
summary: lore-cli's v0.6.2 tag, held pending npm publish (see this repo's persistent memory: opum-lore-pin-held-at-v0.6.1.md), is now actually live on the registry -- dist-tags.latest moved to 0.6.2. Lift the hold: bump the pin. Since the skills/ tree is unchanged from v0.6.1, this is bookkeeping, not a content re-review -- but every number gets re-verified independently rather than carried forward from the peer message anyway.

acceptanceCriteria.text: npm dist-tags.latest independently confirmed as 0.6.2, not taken from the publish claim alone.
v0.6.2 skills/ tree confirmed byte-identical to the v0.6.1/v0.6.0 baseline (24277e9a...), so this is a tag move with no content re-review needed.
plugin.json at v0.6.2 self-declares version 0.6.2, checked directly.
marketplace.json ref and federated-pin-baselines.json entry moved together to v0.6.2.
Both federated checker scripts and their regression suites pass locally against the new pin before landing.

implementationNotes:
AC1-3 verification, run independently rather than taken from lore-cli's message.

AC1: `npm view @opum-ai/lore dist-tags --json` -> {"release-candidate":"0.3.4","latest":"0.6.2"}. Also `npm view @opum-ai/lore version` -> "0.6.2". Confirms the registry moved, not just that a publish command was claimed to have run.

AC2: v0.6.2's skills/ tree was already independently resolved in a prior session on this same task chain (commit ea3813ae39fd9c9bba1e5e24e32a4c73e1611480 -> root tree 9881f02e3ed692843a31ca8dfb6b69f9ec49525e -> skills subtree 24277e9a94d6cc9b5a8c7fa12fa32c4f15eb4c0f), via the GitHub API, not copied from any message. Tags are immutable so this doesn't need re-resolving now -- 24277e9a matches the current opum-lore baseline (v0.6.1) exactly, confirming this move is a pure tag bump with zero content change under skills/.

AC3: fetched https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opum-ai/lore-cli/v0.6.2/.claude-plugin/plugin.json directly -- version field reads "0.6.2", self-consistent.

Also spot-checked (not an AC, but worth recording since it was an explicit claim): `npm view @opum-ai/lore@0.6.2 dist.attestations` returns empty, consistent with lore-cli's LCLI-482 note that manual publishes carry no OIDC/SLSA provenance. Not something either federated checker validates, so it doesn't gate this task -- recorded for the log, not treated as a blocker.
references: lore-cli LCLI-482 (still open: no OIDC/SLSA provenance for manual publishes, including 0.6.2)
finalSummary: Lifted the deliberate hold on opum-lore's pin: npm dist-tags.latest moved to 0.6.2 (confirmed independently -- npm view, not the publish claim), so the skill can now legitimately track the CLI a user can actually install. Since v0.6.2's skills/ tree is byte-identical to v0.6.1's (already resolved independently in an earlier pass: commit ea3813a -> root tree 9881f02e -> skills subtree 24277e9a), this bump changed zero content -- pure bookkeeping, exactly as anticipated when the hold was recorded. plugin.json at the tag self-declares 0.6.2. Moved marketplace.json's ref and the baseline entry together; both federated checkers and their regression suites pass locally (pins/content checkers exit 0, regression suites 5/5 and 8/8). Recorded but out of scope: LCLI-482's missing OIDC/SLSA provenance is an npm-side fact, not a git tag chain fact, so it doesn't touch what either checker validates. Also carried forward lore-cli's standing warning into the baseline note: v0.6.2 is the last tag at the old skills/ tree -- LCLI-480 already moved it on lore-cli main to 2998f74d, so the next tag cut needs a real re-resolve, not a reuse of 24277e9a.
